title: EU CBAM Full Implementation Phase
summary: Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism enters full enforcement. All steel imports must declare embedded emissions and purchase CBAM certificates at EU ETS prices. Non-compliance penalties up to 50 EUR/ton.

title: US Section 232 Steel Tariff Review
summary: Maintained 25% tariff on steel imports from most countries. New quota arrangements with select trading partners. China remains subject to full tariff.

title: India Safeguard Duty Extension
summary: Extended safeguard duty on steel imports for one more year. Rates: 15% on volumes exceeding country quota. Exemptions for select FTA partners.

title: China Export Tax Rebate Adjustment
summary: Reduced VAT export rebate for certain steel products from 13% to 9%. Aims to discourage low-margin exports and reduce trade friction.

title: EU Anti-Dumping Investigation - Cold-Rolled
summary: Initiated anti-dumping investigation on cold-rolled steel from China, India, and Vietnam. Provisional duties possible within 9 months. Alleged dumping margins 15-35%.

title: ASEAN Harmonized Steel Standard
summary: New harmonized technical standards for steel products traded within ASEAN. Certification required for intra-ASEAN trade. Third-country imports must meet equivalent standards.

title: Vietnam Import Licensing Requirement
issuer: Ministry of Industry and Trade, Vietnam
summary: Automatic import licensing system for steel products. Importers must register and report volumes monthly. Aimed at monitoring trade flows and ensuring compliance with anti-circumvention rules.

title: Brazil Minimum Import Price
summary: Imposed minimum import price of USD 580/ton CIF for hot-rolled coil. Customs will assess value against this floor. Anti-circumvention measure targeting undervalued imports.

title: Turkey Additional Customs Duty
summary: Imposed additional 20% customs duty on steel imports exceeding quarterly quota. Measure valid for 6 months, subject to WTO safeguard notification.

title: Japan Green Steel Procurement Policy
issuer: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry
summary: Government procurement will prioritize steel with carbon intensity below 1.8 tons CO2/ton steel. Premium pricing for certified low-carbon products. Applies to public infrastructure projects.

title: Indonesia Nickel Export Ban Extension
issuer: Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources
summary: Extended ban on nickel ore exports indefinitely. Affects silicon steel production costs globally due to nickel content. Promotes domestic smelting and value-added processing.

title: South Korea Emissions Trading System Expansion
summary: Lowered ETS allocation for steel sector by 10%. Carbon price expected to rise. Imported steel indirect emissions now counted toward importer compliance obligations.

title: Mexico Steel Origin Verification Program
summary: Enhanced origin verification for steel imports claiming USMCA benefits. Third-party certification required. Targets circumvention of US Section 232 tariffs via Mexico.

title: UK Carbon Border Tax Proposal
summary: Proposed UK Carbon Border Adjustment parallel to EU CBAM. Public consultation until Oct 2026. Expected rate aligned with UK ETS (currently 45-50 GBP/ton CO2).

title: Australia Critical Minerals Strategy
issuer: Department of Industry, Science and Resources
summary: AUD 500M fund to support rare earth and silicon processing. Benefits silicon steel producers using domestic materials. Export finance available for value-added products.

title: Thailand BOI Investment Incentives
summary: Tax holidays for cold-rolled steel manufacturing with advanced coating technology. 8-year corporate income tax exemption. Targets EV and electronics supply chain development.

title: Canada Underutilized Capacity Tariff
summary: 25% surtax on hot-rolled imports when domestic capacity utilization falls below 80%. Currently triggered. Measure applies to non-USMCA countries.

title: Philippines Anti-Circumvention Duty
summary: Extended anti-dumping duties to cold-rolled steel transshipped via third countries. Additional 18-32% duty on products from China routed through Vietnam and Thailand.

title: EU Deforestation Regulation Impact
summary: Steel packaging materials must comply with deforestation-free requirements. Traceability documentation for wooden packaging and pallets. Minor compliance burden but mandatory.

title: Singapore Carbon Tax Increase
summary: Carbon tax raised from SGD 35 to SGD 50 per ton CO2. Affects port operations and logistics emissions. Indirect cost increase for steel transshipment through Singapore.
